<?php

class FenwickTree {
    public array $val;

    public function __construct(int $n) {
        $this->val = array_fill(0, $n + 1, 0);
    }

    public function add(int $x, int $v): void {
        $n = count($this->val) - 1;
        while ($x <= $n) {
            $this->val[$x] += $v;
            $x += $x & (-$x);
        }
    }

    public function sum(int $x): int {
        if ($x >= count($this->val)) {
            throw new Exception("Index out of bounds");
        }
        $ans = 0;
        while ($x > 0) {
            $ans += $this->val[$x];
            $x -= $x & (-$x);
        }
        return $ans;
    }
}

function sieve(int $n): array {
    $is_prime = array_fill(0, $n + 1, true);
    $is_prime[0] = false;
    if ($n >= 1) $is_prime[1] = false;
    for ($i = 2; ; $i++) {
        if ($i * $i > $n) {
            break;
        }
        if ($is_prime[$i]) {
            $j = $i * $i;
            while ($j <= $n) {
                $is_prime[$j] = false;
                $j += $i;
            }
        }
    }
    $prime = [];
    for ($i = 2; $i <= $n; $i++) {
        if ($is_prime[$i]) {
            $prime[] = (int)$i;
        }
    }
    return $prime;
}

class PrimeCountSolver {
    public array $query;
    public array $memo;

    public function __construct() {
        $this->query = [];
        $this->memo = [];
    }

    public function add(int $n): void {
        $this->query[] = $n;
    }

    private function binary_search_by_square(array $p, int $v): int {
        $lo = 0;
        $hi = count($p);
        while ($lo < $hi) {
            $mid = intdiv($lo + $hi, 2);
            $sq = $p[$mid] * $p[$mid];
            if ($sq < $v) {
                $lo = $mid + 1;
            } else if ($sq > $v) {
                $hi = $mid;
            } else {
                return $mid; // exact
            }
        }
        return ~$lo; // not found, bitwise complement of insertion point
    }

    public function build(): void {
        sort($this->query);
        $this->query = array_values(array_unique($this->query));
        $n = count($this->query) ? end($this->query) : 1;
        $m = 1;
        while (($m + 1) * ($m + 1) <= $n) {
            $m++;
        }
        $p = sieve($m);
        $bound = (int)(pow($n, 1.0 / 3.0) ** 2) + 2;

        $stack = [];
        foreach ($this->query as $v) {
            $bs = $this->binary_search_by_square($p, $v);
            if ($bs >= 0) {
                $k = $bs + 1;
            } else {
                $k = ~ $bs;
            }
            $stack[] = [$v, $k];
        }

        $query = [];
        while (!empty($stack)) {
            [$nn, $k] = array_pop($stack);
            if ($k == 0) {
                continue;
            }
            $q = $p[$k - 1];
            if ($q * $q > $nn) {
                $sub = array_slice($p, 0, $k);
                $bs = $this->binary_search_by_square($sub, $nn);
                if ($bs >= 0) {
                    $x = $bs + 1;
                } else {
                    $x = ~ $bs;
                }
                $stack[] = [$nn, $x];
            } else if ($nn <= $bound) {
                $query[] = [$k, $nn];
            } else {
                $stack[] = [$nn, $k - 1];
                $stack[] = [intdiv($nn, $q), $k - 1];
            }
        }

        sort($query);
        $query = array_values(array_unique($query, SORT_REGULAR));

        $m = $bound;
        $bit = new FenwickTree($m);
        for ($i = 1; $i <= $m; $i++) {
            $bit->add($i, 1);
        }

        $is_prime = array_fill(0, $m + 1, true);
        $memo = array_fill(0, count($query), 0);
        $pos = 0;

        foreach ($p as $i => $pp) {
            $pp_int = (int)$pp;
            $j = $pp_int;
            while ($j <= $m) {
                if ($is_prime[$j]) {
                    $bit->add($j, -1);
                }
                $is_prime[$j] = false;
                $j += $pp_int;
            }
            while ($pos < count($query)) {
                [$k, $nn] = $query[$pos];
                if ($k > $i + 1) {
                    break;
                } else {
                    $memo[$pos] = $bit->sum($nn);
                    $pos++;
                }
            }
            if ($pos >= count($query)) {
                break;
            }
        }

        $this->memo = array_fill(0, count($this->query), 0);
        $stack = [];
        foreach ($this->query as $idx => $nn) {
            $bs = $this->binary_search_by_square($p, $nn);
            if ($bs >= 0) {
                $k = $bs + 1;
            } else {
                $k = ~ $bs;
            }
            $this->memo[$idx] += $k - 1;
            $stack[] = [$nn, $k, 1, $idx];
        }

        while (!empty($stack)) {
            [$nn, $k, $sign, $idx] = array_pop($stack);
            if ($k == 0) {
                $this->memo[$idx] += $sign * $nn;
                continue;
            }
            $q = $p[$k - 1];
            if ($q * $q > $nn) {
                $sub = array_slice($p, 0, $k);
                $bs = $this->binary_search_by_square($sub, $nn);
                if ($bs >= 0) {
                    $x = $bs + 1;
                } else {
                    $x = ~ $bs;
                }
                $this->memo[$idx] += -$sign * ($k - $x);
                $stack[] = [$nn, $x, $sign, $idx];
            } else if ($nn <= $bound) {
                $key = [$k, $nn];
                $q_idx = array_search($key, $query);
                $this->memo[$idx] += $sign * $memo[$q_idx];
            } else {
                $stack[] = [$nn, $k - 1, $sign, $idx];
                $stack[] = [intdiv($nn, $q), $k - 1, -$sign, $idx];
            }
        }
    }

    public function get(int $n): int {
        $idx = array_search($n, $this->query);
        return $this->memo[$idx];
    }
}

function run(): void {

            if ($q * $q > $n2) {

    }

    public function get(int $n): int {

class FenwickTree {
    public array $val;

    public function __construct(int $n) {
        $this->val = array_fill(0, $n + 1, 0);
    }

    public function add(int $x, int $v): void {
        $n = count($this->val) - 1;
        while ($x <= $n) {
            $this->val[$x] += $v;
            $x += $x & (-$x);
        }
    }

    public function sum(int $x): int {
        if ($x >= count($this->val)) {
            throw new Exception("Index out of bounds");
        }
        $ans = 0;
        while ($x > 0) {
            $ans += $this->val[$x];
            $x -= $x & (-$x);
        }
        return $ans;
    }
}

function sieve(int $n): array {
    $is_prime = array_fill(0, $n + 1, true);
    $is_prime[0] = false;
    if ($n >= 1) $is_prime[1] = false;
    for ($i = 2; ; $i++) {
        if ($i * $i > $n) {
            break;
        }
        if ($is_prime[$i]) {
            $j = $i * $i;
            while ($j <= $n) {
                $is_prime[$j] = false;
                $j += $i;
            }
        }
    }
    $prime = [];
    for ($i = 2; $i <= $n; $i++) {
        if ($is_prime[$i]) {
            $prime[] = (int)$i;
        }
    }
    return $prime;
}

class PrimeCountSolver {
    public array $query;
    public array $memo;

    public function __construct() {
        $this->query = [];
        $this->memo = [];
    }

    public function add(int $n): void {
        $this->query[] = $n;
    }

    public function build(): void {
        sort($this->query);
        $this->query = array_values(array_unique($this->query));
        $n = count($this->query) ? end($this->query) : 1;
        $m = 1;
        while (($m + 1) * ($m + 1) <= $n) {
            $m++;
        }
        $p = sieve($m);
        $bound = (int)(pow($n, 1.0 / 3.0) ** 2) + 2;
        $stack = [];
        foreach ($this->query as $v) {
            $k = self::binary_search_p2($p, $v);
            $stack[] = [$v, $k];
        }
        $query = [];
        while (!empty($stack)) {
            [$nn, $k] = array_pop($stack);
            if ($k == 0) {
                continue;
            }
            $q = $p[$k - 1];
            if ($q * $q > $nn) {
                $x = self::binary_search_p2(array_slice($p, 0, $k), $nn);
                $stack[] = [$nn, $x];
            } elseif ($nn <= $bound) {
                $query[] = [$k, $nn];
            } else {
                $stack[] = [$nn, $k - 1];
                $stack[] = [intdiv($nn, $q), $k - 1];
            }
        }
        sort($query);
        $query = array_values(array_unique($query, SORT_REGULAR));
        $m = $bound;
        $bit = new FenwickTree($m);
        for ($i = 1; $i <= $m; $i++) {
            $bit->add($i, 1);
        }
        $is_prime = array_fill(0, $m + 1, true);
        $memo = array_fill(0, count($query), 0);
        $pos = 0;
        foreach ($p as $i => $pp) {
            $pp_int = (int)$pp;
            $j = $pp_int;
            while ($j <= $m) {
                if ($is_prime[$j]) {
                    $bit->add($j, -1);
                }
                $is_prime[$j] = false;
                $j += $pp_int;
            }
            while ($pos < count($query)) {
                [$k, $nn] = $query[$pos];
                if ($k > $i + 1) {
                    break;
                } else {
                    $memo[$pos] = $bit->sum($nn);
                    $pos++;
                }
            }
            if ($pos >= count($query)) {
                break;
            }
        }
        $this->memo = array_fill(0, count($this->query), 0);
        $stack = [];
        foreach ($this->query as $i => $nn) {
            $k = self::binary_search_p2($p, $nn);
            $this->memo[$i] += $k - 1;
            $stack[] = [$nn, $k, 1, $i];
        }
        while (!empty($stack)) {
            [$nn, $k, $sign, $idx] = array_pop($stack);
            if ($k == 0) {
                $this->memo[$idx] += $sign * $nn;
                continue;
            }
            $q = $p[$k - 1];
            if ($q * $q > $nn) {
                $x = self::binary_search_p2(array_slice($p, 0, $k), $nn);
                $this->memo[$idx] += -$sign * ($k - $x);
                $stack[] = [$nn, $x, $sign, $idx];
            } elseif ($nn <= $bound) {
                $pos = self::binary_search_pair($query, [$k, $nn]);
                $this->memo[$idx] += $sign * $memo[$pos];
            } else {
                $stack[] = [$nn, $k - 1, $sign, $idx];
                $stack[] = [intdiv($nn, $q), $k - 1, -$sign, $idx];
            }
        }
    }

    private static function binary_search_p2(array $p, int $v): int {
        $low = 0;
        $high = count($p);
        while ($low < $high) {
            $mid = intdiv($low + $high, 2);
            $val = $p[$mid] * $p[$mid];
            if ($val == $v) {
                return $mid + 1;
            } elseif ($val < $v) {
                $low = $mid + 1;
            } else {
                $high = $mid;
            }
        }
        return $low;
    }

    private static function binary_search_pair(array $arr, array $target): int {
        $low = 0;
        $high = count($arr);
        while ($low < $high) {
            $mid = intdiv($low + $high, 2);
            if ($arr[$mid][0] < $target[0] || ($arr[$mid][0] == $target[0] && $arr[$mid][1] < $target[1])) {
                $low = $mid + 1;
            } else {
                $high = $mid;
            }
        }
        return $low;
    }

    public function get(int $n): int {
        $idx = self::binary_search_value($this->query, $n);
        return $this->memo[$idx];
    }

    private static function binary_search_value(array $arr, int $v): int {
        $low = 0;
        $high = count($arr);
        while ($low < $high) {
            $mid = intdiv($low + $high, 2);
            if ($arr[$mid] < $v) {
                $low = $mid + 1;
            } else {
                $high = $mid;
            }
        }
        return $low;
    }
}
